_comment: Golden vocabulary vector for a Signal's data_type. One checked-in dataset judged by BOTH the Python suite (colca-data-contracts/tests/test_signal_data_types.py, against utils.enums.signal.DataType) and the editor UI's suite (ui/tests/signal-data-type-vocabulary.spec.ts, against SIGNAL_DATA_TYPES). The two native copies drifted once already: the browser modelled a Signal with the CONSTANT vocabulary ('Float64', 'Int64'), the read path translated the difference away, and the write path sent 'float64' -- which a Signal cannot hold, so saving one with a semantic type that declares a data type was refused outright.
_arrays_comment: Array variants exist on the server (int_array, float_array, …) and are deliberately NOT offered by the entity editor. They are excluded here so this vector says what a picker may present, not everything the column accepts.
